WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(archstat, 'missing') as status,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY COALESCE(archstat, 'missing')
),
total_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as total_count,
    COUNT(*) as num_statuses,
    1.0 / COUNT(*) as avg_share
  FROM status_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.status,
    sc.count,
    sc.count * 1.0 / ts.total_count as share,
    sc.count * 1.0 / ts.total_count - ts.avg_share as above_average,
    ts.avg_share
  FROM status_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN total_stats ts
)
SELECT 
  status,
  count,
  share,
  above_average
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC
